objective: Connect the existing R-Code v1 platform components into a durable, provider-bound, read-only PRD planning path whose configuration cannot drift during a run.
end_state: A GUI-created task preserves its selected provider/model and current checkout, the daemon persists an immutable planning RunSnapshot, the model broker preserves system and tool semantics, a plan is persisted and approved by exact revision, and P-GATE proves that no write-capable tool is reachable before approval.
non_goals: Parallel WorkUnit or child-agent execution before O-GATE
Automatic Git staging, commits, pushes, index writes or ref writes

environment.os: Windows development host; Windows/macOS/Linux product targets
environment.notes: The working tree already contains user-owned Harness v1, prompt and provider changes. Use snapshots and never reset, bulk-format, commit or push.

components.description: A content-addressed configuration snapshot bound to every attempt.

tasks.title: Persist immutable planning and execution run snapshots
tasks.description: Add typed snapshot contracts and V1Store persistence, keeping planning snapshots plan-less while execution snapshots require an exact approval reference.

files.what: Define snapshot contracts and bind Attempt to snapshot identity.
Add run snapshot schema and migration metadata.
Persist and load immutable snapshots.
Expose the run snapshot repository.

subtasks.description: Define provider, prompt, workspace, permission and plan snapshot references with deterministic SHA-256 identity.
Persist snapshots insert-only and reject the same id with different content.
Preserve serde compatibility for legacy Attempt rows while requiring new attempts to reference a snapshot.

tests.description: Snapshot canonical hash is deterministic and changes for every material input.
V1Store round-trips snapshots and rejects conflicting reuse.
Existing v1 databases migrate without losing tasks or events.

acceptance_criteria: Planning snapshots allow no plan revision; execution and repair snapshots require an approval reference.
Run snapshots are immutable and content-addressed.
No credential material is serialized in a snapshot.

tasks.title: Make daemon provider settings revisioned and snapshot-resolvable
tasks.description: Add atomic settings revisions, explicit corruption errors and a credential-free provider route snapshot resolved once per run.

files.what: CAS revisions, atomic writes, fail-closed loads and route snapshot resolution.
Supply the profile credential namespace.
Compose settings with the resolved runtime profile.
Expose checked reads and revision-aware mutation RPCs.

subtasks.description: Add revision and expected-revision CAS to V1Settings.
Replace truncate-write and silent parse fallback with atomic replace and typed errors.
Resolve provider/model/base URL/protocol/capability metadata without exposing credentials.

tests.description: Concurrent stale settings writes are rejected.
Corrupt JSON fails closed and the previous file survives interrupted replacement.
Changing settings after resolution does not mutate a route snapshot.

acceptance_criteria: Daemon settings are revisioned and written atomically.
Corruption is distinguishable from an empty configuration.
Resolved route metadata contains no API key.
Production composition uses the profile credential namespace and daemon RPCs preserve checked/CAS semantics.

tasks.title: Freeze the selected provider, prompt and checkout before dispatch
tasks.description: Construct and persist the planning snapshot before run.started, then derive harness configuration from that snapshot only.

files.what: Expose a serializable current-checkout identity.
Resolve one provider instance and credential-free route for the run.
Provide a frozen single-route resolver for a run.
Build frozen snapshots outside the run orchestration loop.
Expose the snapshot builder module.
Build, persist and consume one immutable snapshot per run.
Project credential-free run snapshot metadata.
Disable injected-model fallback for every real daemon profile.
Query the latest snapshot metadata for task projections.
Add revision-fenced task saves and checkpoint handoff between attempt namespaces.

subtasks.description: Canonicalize the task workspace and reject invalid or missing bindings for implementation work.
Freeze route, prompt, package, tool catalog, permissions and workspace before starting the plugin.
Use the persisted snapshot for checkpoint resume and all model calls in the run.

tests.description: Provider and prompt changes during a run affect only the next run.
Checkpoint resume preserves the original snapshot id.
The run view exposes metadata but never credentials.

acceptance_criteria: run.started is never emitted before the snapshot is durable.
No live settings read can change an active run.
The selected current checkout, not the profile workspaces directory, is the snapshot workspace.

tasks.title: Carry GUI provider and engine selection into the daemon task
tasks.description: Remove the create-task parameter sink and persist provider/model/engine route preferences through the v1 bridge.

files.what: Persist an explicit provider-neutral task model route.
Freeze HostProvider and harness-managed routes correctly.
Create a task with title, route, preferences and harness selection.
Accept additive route fields in task create/preferences and project them.
Commit task state, route event and selection package pin atomically.
Forward provider and engine values.
Encode route preferences in daemon task creation.
Keep daemon-backed route creation and mutation logic focused.
Register the focused v1 route bridge module.
Expose the compatible v1 task-create fields if the typed client requires them.
Send concrete model and inference in the initial create request.
Remove legacy post-create model/inference writes.

subtasks.description: Extend the v1 create request additively without breaking old clients.
Validate HostProvider versus CodexAccount route combinations.
Return the persisted selection in task projections.

tests.description: DeepSeek selection survives GUI create, daemon persistence and task reload.
Old create requests still use daemon defaults.
Invalid provider/engine combinations fail before a run starts.

acceptance_criteria: cmd_task_create no longer discards provider_name or agent_engine.
Task creation is wire-compatible with existing v1 clients.
The next run snapshot uses the task-bound route.

tasks.title: Preserve canonical transcript roles in ModelBroker
tasks.description: Project the wire system message into CompletionRequest.system and tool results into provider-compatible user tool-result blocks while keeping assistant tool calls intact.

files.what: Add the canonical developer role additively.
Correct request projection and provider-aware output limits.
Reject unknown roles and keep the canonical transcript stable.
Propagate transcript projection errors without starting a model request.

subtasks.description: Extract system blocks into the provider system field without duplicating them as user messages.
Map tool results to user messages containing ToolResult blocks.
Derive max tokens and inference from the frozen request instead of a hard-coded constant.

tests.description: Golden requests preserve system, user, assistant tool calls and tool results.
DeepSeek/OpenAI/Anthropic fake adapters receive equivalent canonical turns.

acceptance_criteria: System content is sent exactly once through CompletionRequest.system.
Tool results are never projected as assistant messages.
Unknown transcript roles fail closed rather than becoming assistant.

tasks.title: Persist exact PlanRevision approvals
tasks.description: Promote plan JSON from review-key storage into explicit immutable revisions and persist exact-hash approval records separately from effect approvals.

files.what: Add immutable revision identity and approval lifecycle.
Add plan revisions and approvals tables.
Persist plan and approval atomically.
Validate active exact approval before persisting execution or repair snapshots.

subtasks.description: Canonicalize and hash plan revisions including route, workspace, scopes, checks and WorkUnits.
Approve with actor and expected revision CAS; reject stale or superseded revisions.
Make the execution snapshot builder require the valid approval record.

tests.description: Approve, revise and stale-approval behavior is deterministic.
Approval and plan revision survive daemon restart.

acceptance_criteria: Effect approvals and Plan approvals remain separate aggregates.
Only the exact approved plan hash can be used by an execution snapshot.
Changing any material plan input supersedes approval.

tasks.title: Route plan, context, artifact and verification host services
tasks.description: Attach existing context, artifact, plan, question, child and verification services to HostRouter instead of advertising unimplemented methods.

files.what: Implement the declared host-service routes.
Construct and attach per-run service instances and child supervision.
Compose task-scoped context and artifact roots.
Synchronize canonical model messages into a durable transcript.
Support task-scoped durable artifact stores.
Compose the production services.

subtasks.description: Route context and artifact reads/writes with task ownership.
Route plan publish/update and durable questions.
Route verification and attach ChildSupervisor with the parent permission ceiling.

tests.description: Every service requested by the native manifest is either operational or absent from negotiated grants.
Cross-task context/artifact handles and stale child callbacks are rejected.

acceptance_criteria: The router has no advertised-but-unimplemented native host service.
All routes preserve run identity, generation fencing and ownership.
Verification remains host-owned.

tasks.title: Run the durable read-only planning backend
tasks.description: Make unapproved code work execute as a read-only Planning Run, publish an immutable PlanRevision and settle in AwaitingPlanApproval.

files.what: Add AwaitingPlanApproval and Ready transitions.
Add a typed PlanPublish reply.
Expose PlanPublish to harnesses.
Publish a deterministic PlanDraft in planning mode.
Create current-checkout read-only planning tools.
Freeze the read-only planning tool catalog and force planning posture.
Return typed PlanPublish replies for all pre-approval code tasks.
Bind pre-v1 compatibility to exact trusted built-in package identity.
Force pre-approval code tasks through planning and AwaitingPlanApproval.
Expose plan read and exact approval operations.
Expose additive plan.get and plan.approve daemon RPCs.
Atomically approve/invalidate a plan and update its task state.
Support task-state CAS within plan approval transactions.
Persist host-owned built-in provenance for exact package digests.

subtasks.description: Expose only current-checkout read/list/search tools during Planning.
Publish a deterministic plan and transition to AwaitingPlanApproval.
Approve the exact hash and atomically transition to Ready without starting implementation.

tests.description: Fake Provider PRD planning reaches AwaitingPlanApproval without changing the workspace.
Write/process/child/verification calls are undiscoverable and guessed calls are denied.
Exact approval survives restart; stale approval is rejected.

acceptance_criteria: No workspace write occurs before exact PlanRevision approval.
A published PlanDraft settles in AwaitingPlanApproval, not ReviewReady.
Approval marks Ready atomically and never auto-starts implementation.

tasks.title: Project exact plan approval through the desktop P-GATE
tasks.description: Route existing desktop Plan views to daemon v1 and prove the complete GUI PRD-to-Ready vertical slice.

files.what: Route plan get/create/approve through the v1 bridge.
Project daemon plan state into the existing PlanView.
Send the exact PlanRevision hash for approval.
Remove the obsolete old-store planCreate step.
Hide legacy-only actions for daemon v1 immutable plans.

subtasks.description: Project PlanRevision and approval state into the existing desktop PlanView.
Approve using plan.id as the exact revision hash and refresh stale plans.
Prove GUI create, planning, approval and Ready replay after daemon restart.

tests.description: Desktop Plan get/approve uses daemon data and exact hashes.
PRD to plan to approval reaches Ready after restart.

acceptance_criteria: The GUI no longer reads or approves the old PlanStore for v1 tasks.
Approval always carries the exact revision hash.
P-GATE is deterministic with the fake Provider.
